strategy.name: Inherited nuclei plus old marginal provinces and dated gateways
strategy.reason: The six-body target passes dated geometry, bounded gateway physics, inherited/synthetic plate-block kinematics, continental-crust accounting, and a 1-degree spatial crustal-thickness/stretching/freeboard existence reconstruction. No Strategy B motion or continent-scale coastline repair is required.

motion_policy.alternate_frame_role: MULLER2022 is an explicit sensitivity check and is not silently mixed into the primary reconstruction.
motion_policy.rule: Rigid nuclei use inherited rotation circuits; broad junction/collisional regions are deforming networks. All authored gateway-forming rigid-block rotations finish by 2 Ma or earlier. Later uplift, subsidence, boundary slip, erosion, volcanism, glaciation and sea-level response may continue.

resolved_constraints.question: Can a crustal-thickness, deformation and freeboard history generate the six final envelopes while conserving continental crust?
resolved_constraints.result: Yes at the required existence/necessary-condition level.
resolved_constraints.evidence: The 1-degree material mesh closes a 210.4 million km2 continental-crust inventory to ~0.0004%, reproduces sampled present candidate land/water signs, leaves ~24.6% of continental crust submerged, requires zero net new continental crust, uses 21-42 km present crust and beta <=1.67, and exposes ~16.84 million km2 of additional shallow shelf at a -80 m lowstand while local deep-water channels remain submerged.

unresolved_constraints.question: What time-dependent climate/ice solution realizes the C4 peripheral refugia on the solved crust/freeboard surface?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Do not redraw C4 unless a higher-fidelity climate/ice model specifically contradicts the corridor.

unresolved_constraints.question: What detailed local relative-sea-level/isostatic history refines the already passing H06/H07/H10 northern sill states?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Refine bathymetry, eustasy, isostasy and geoid effects without continent-scale motion.

unresolved_constraints.question: What current/wind/voyage solution realizes the passing eastern 54.7/28.3/75.0 km crossing network?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Do not add islands unless a hydrodynamic/founder model specifically fails.

unresolved_constraints.question: What detailed C3 relief/drainage/hydroclimate realizes the already bounded intermittent-contact state machine?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Refine relief and drainage before changing coastline.

fallback_strategy.trigger: Only a later specific C1-C2 deforming-mesh incompatibility that survives local Strategy A repair.
fallback_strategy.description: Promote the C1-C2 junction to a separately reconstructed microplate system and permit modest pre-1.9 Ma rotations of both adjacent bodies.
